definitions.explanation: Multiple days; can refer to the passing of time or daily activities.

examples.japanese: {日々|ひび}の{生活|せいかつ}を{大切|たいせつ}にする。
{忙|いそが}しい{日々|ひび}を{送|おく}っている。
あの{日々|ひび}は{二度|にど}と{戻|もど}らない。
examples.english: Those days will never come back.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}どもの{頃|ころ}の{日々|ひび}を{時々|ときどき}{思|おも}い{出|だ}します。
examples.english: I sometimes remember the days of my childhood.

examples.japanese: {日々|ひび}{成長|せいちょう}しています。
{技術|ぎじゅつ}は{日々|ひび}{進歩|しんぽ}している。
examples.english: Technology is advancing day by day.

examples.japanese: {日々|ひび}{努力|どりょく}を{続|つづ}けることが{大切|たいせつ}です。
examples.english: It's important to keep making an effort every day.

examples.japanese: {日本語|にほんご}が{日々|ひび}{上手|じょうず}になっているのを{感|かん}じます。
examples.english: I can feel my Japanese getting better day by day.

notes:
{日々|ひび} is a literary/formal word meaning "days" or "daily," formed by reduplication of {日|ひ}.

USAGE TYPES:
1. Noun: multiple days, the passing days
2. Adverb: day by day, daily

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {日々|ひび}の{生活|せいかつ}: daily life
- {日々|ひび}{成長|せいちょう}する: to grow day by day
- {日々|ひび}を{送|おく}る: to spend one's days
- {忙|いそが}しい{日々|ひび}: busy days

REGISTER:
More literary and formal than {毎日|まいにち}. Often used when reflecting on time passing or in written/poetic contexts.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {毎日|まいにち}: every day (neutral, everyday usage)
- {日常|にちじょう}: daily life, everyday (noun)
- {年々|ねんねん}: year by year (same pattern)
